description: Tests for handling near-duplicate records with slightly modified text or timestamps. Robustness category B.

fixtures.input_condition: Two records with different record_ids but near-identical text describing the same event

source_records.text: TEST FIXTURE: Ravi Malhotra observed at Andheri Warehouse at 22:00.
TEST FIXTURE: Ravi Malhotra observed near Andheri Warehouse around 22:00.

fixtures.expected_behavior: Both records are currently ingested as distinct records since record_ids differ, leading to inflated co-occurrence weight.
fixtures.rationale: Without semantic text similarity or MinHash deduplication, near-duplicate text under distinct record IDs creates multiple records.
fixtures.weakness_description: No fuzzy or semantic deduplication is implemented. Near-duplicate records under different IDs inflate edge co-occurrence weights.
